params.negative: worst quality, low quality, score_1, score_2, score_3, artist name

card.architecture: Anima 2B anime base (Qwen3-0.6B encoder, Qwen-Image VAE), ImagePadForOutpaint + masked img2img (same op as anima-inpaint)
card.summary: Extend an image beyond its edges with Anima. The source is padded on each side by pad_left/top/right/bottom (source-native pixels); only the new border is generated (masked img2img) from the prompt, feathered into the original, which is preserved. Use it to add head/foot room or widen a character's framing.
card.pick_when: You want to EXTEND the canvas outward (add margin on one or more sides) and let Anima fill the new area, keeping the original pixels.

prompt.guidance: Type the FULL prompt for the whole enlarged image; the added border is generated to match it and the quality prefix is added automatically. Booru tags, lowercase with spaces; artists prefixed with '@'. The pad_* amounts (in source pixels) come from the caller.
prompt.example: 1girl, solo, full body, standing, plain background, @artistname

negative.note: Default: 'worst quality, low quality, score_1, score_2, score_3, artist name'.

ui_help.note: Set how many pixels to extend on each side, add a prompt, and send; the new margin is generated and blended into the original. 'Seam feather' softens the join.
ui_help.good_for: outpainting / extending an image's canvas on any side while keeping the original

edit_use_cases: outpaint: extend the canvas outward on any side (pad_left/top/right/bottom px) and fill the new border from the prompt, keeping the original
